notes: New: a QR code for your mirror link in Settings, with Download PNG and Download SVG (print) buttons. It is generated from the mirror-link field itself so it can never drift from the link you share, drawn at integer module scale with the spec's 4-module quiet zone so it stays scannable in print. Also: software updates are now re-checked every 30 minutes while the app runs instead of once at launch; a permanent Settings link on the hub so updates can never be stranded; the full local hub is restored (Facilitator Dashboard, TV Display + Video Ads, Mobile Status Viewer) while the website still publishes only the Mobile Status Viewer; /display is retired and forwards without choosing a location; a bare /client with no ?id= shows a 'No location selected' panel; malformed instance ids return 400; and the queue grid rebuilds when Settings changes the layout.
